inspiration.observed_pattern: A grouped report uses overall distinct counts and conditional distinct counts to calculate a retained-user ratio.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored cohort, two active users, one day-seven user, and one CTE-backed grouped INSERT ... SELECT with a guarded percentage.

fixture_notes: One cohort has two active users and one retained user, so the persisted result is 50.00 percent.
determinism_notes: Fixed cohort, user IDs, day numbers, literal percentage calculation, and ordered final read; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE cohort_activity_min (activity_id INT PRIMARY KEY, cohort_day DATE NOT NULL, user_id INT NOT NULL, day_number INT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE cohort_retention_min (cohort_day DATE PRIMARY KEY, install_count INT NOT NULL, retained_count INT NOT NULL, retention_pct DECIMAL(6,2) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: INSERT INTO cohort_retention_min (cohort_day, install_count, retained_count, retention_pct) WITH activity_data AS (SELECT cohort_day, user_id, day_number FROM cohort_activity_min) SELECT cohort_day, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id), COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN day_number >= 7 THEN user_id END), ROUND(100 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN day_number >= 7 THEN user_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT user_id), 0), 2) FROM activity_data GROUP BY cohort_day

checks.sql: SELECT cohort_day, install_count, retained_count, retention_pct FROM cohort_retention_min ORDER BY cohort_day
